critical_code_review_comments: notes.py cleanly separates fact-sheet construction (code-computed counts) from LLM output; SYSTEM prompt forbids making up data and requires 'Not recorded' - correct guardrail for clinical notes.
notes.headings_ok validates 6 headings present AND in order; draft_from_sheet retries once if the LLM returns malformed headings, then raises -> 502 FAIL to UI.
notes.unknown_numbers logs any numeric tokens in the draft not present in the fact sheet - good hallucination tripwire (logged, not blocked, matching requirement spirit).
ended_review enforces 409 'Available after the run ends' and 409 'This attempt already has a saved note' before any LLM call - prevents wasted model spend and respects the one-note-per-attempt rule.
save_note uses DuplicateKeyError on progress_notes to make the save idempotent across concurrent approve clicks; relies on a unique index on attempt_id (ensure migration created it).
machine.machine_entity side->type mapping: left->REPLAN_RIGHT, right/ahead->REPLAN_LEFT - matches 'keep left/right' advice copy.

machine.checkpoint_positions subtracts the first trail point to produce start-relative positions (first checkpoint ~ origin); returns {} when no 3D memory, so 2D routes correctly surface position=null.
machine.route_memory filters is_test routes (returns 404) and strips _id via projection - correct hidden-test-route and ObjectId handling.
review.py exposes 'machine' only on items that have a corresponding confirmed entity (keyed by from_event_id) - no leakage onto generic timeline items.
run.py has no notes/machine fields in its response models - clean separation from the review payload.
